translations.web: I will destroy mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs. I will make the rivers islands, and will dry up the pools.
translations.bsb: I will lay waste the mountains and hills and dry up all their vegetation. I will turn the rivers into dry land and drain the marshes.
translations.kjv: I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and I will dry up the pools.
translations.asv: I will lay waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and will dry up the pools.
